transcript: In today's technology news, electric car sales rose sharply across Europe this quarter. Cities are adding thousands of new charging stations along major highways. Meanwhile, battery prices continued to fall, making smaller models more affordable for families. Analysts expect the trend to continue next year.
selection_rule: Per scene: (1) statistics -> animated stat card. (2) Stock candidates from category-suited sources are scored with CLIP (image vs scene visual plan + narration, minus penalty for negative/avoid terms); unsafe candidates (avoid list, faces when avoided, AI for people/brands/sensitive) are removed. (3) Global assignment takes the highest (scene, clip) pairs first, each clip used once, if score >= tau=0.24. (4) If a scene's best stock score < tau+0.03 and AI is allowed, an AI image is generated and wins only if its CLIP score >= stock + 0.02. (5) Otherwise the best unused clip within 0.03 of tau, else a text card.
